description: Create a new client group in Karbon. Members are existing contacts and/or organizations.

ClientOwner.description: Email address of the Karbon user who owns this client relationship

ContactType.description: Contact type label, e.g. 'Client'. Valid values come from get_tenant_settings.

EntityDescription.description: Free-form description of the client group

FullName.description: The full name of the client group

ContactKey.description: ContactKey of a person to include in the group
